note: Voice samples for the cast, made offline with the Kokoro voice model (docs/licenses/kokoro-tts.md) by Tools/voice/make_voice_samples.py. Each character has voice options to choose from; 'chosen' is the owner's pick. 'shift' raises (above 1) or lowers (below 1) pitch and voice size together, which makes a child sound younger; 'speed' is the final pace. Samples only: spoken dialogue reverses Q-14 and waits for the owner.

moods.note: How a line is shaped for each mood (World/rules/dialogue.json moods). semitones: pitch up or down; speed: pace; tilt: tone colour, above 0 brighter and below 0 darker; edge: a little grit; peak: loudness; punctuation: how the voice model is asked to phrase it (the words never change). The generator can also lay a melody over the line and put a sound before it (melody, depth, breath, before); the owner found those too much (2026-11-22), so they are off.
